items.title: Over a base containing the rationals the de Rham complex of a line bundle is quasi-isomorphic to that of the base, via an explicit homotopy

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that over a base containing the rationals the de Rham complex of a line bundle is quasi-isomorphic to the pullback of that of the base, so the de Rham cohomology does not change (statement lines 1527-1532). The proof reduces to the affine statement for a polynomial algebra, where it writes down an explicit homotopy inverse and homotopy, the latter using integration of polynomials with rational coefficients. The explicit homotopy is the substance, so the claim is H2.
